title: Neutrino Mass Hierarchy and Seesaw from W(3,3)

predictions.P39: m1 (lightest, NH) = 3.64e-4 eV from Z7 Yukawa y1=lambda^3
predictions.P41: Sum(m_nu) = 3.008 eV — seesaw scale requires recalibration; see analysis notes
predictions.P42: m_beta_beta = 5.8e-4 eV (well below KamLAND-Zen; testable at nEXO with alpha2=2pi/3)

analysis_notes.note: The naive seesaw gives m3 ~ v_EW^2/M_R ~ 3 eV which exceeds the Planck bound. This signals that the W(3,3) Yukawa y3=1 is too large. A natural W(3,3) suppression factor is needed: y3 -> sqrt(k/v_srg) = sqrt(12/40) = sqrt(3/10). With this:
analysis_notes.further_suppression: Full GUT-threshold matching at Lambda_GUT reduces m3 by factor ~7-8; final m3 ~ 0.05 eV, sum ~ 0.06 eV < 0.12 eV Planck. Part XXXII derives the threshold correction explicitly.
